title: 📱 Leak: Paid 'Galaxy AI' May Raise the Limit on Custom 'Now Brief' Cards — But the Balance Isn't Free!
body: 📱 Leak: Paid 'Galaxy AI' May Raise the Limit on Custom 'Now Brief' Cards — But the Balance Isn't Free!

A new leak from an early build of the One UI 9.5 interface revealed that Samsung is preparing a paid plan called Galaxy AI Premium, and that the first feature it may affect is the custom Now Brief cards — cards the user chooses to display information such as weather, health, and video in their daily summary.

Today, every user can create up to three custom cards for free. According to the leaked card-limits page, this free limit will stay as is for the Standard AI plan, while the paid plan allows creating more cards — though it is not yet known how many extra cards it will unlock. But the subscription alone is not enough: creating or editing cards will consume 'AI Plan Balance' — points shared across the user's devices connected to the same Samsung account — while the card limit stays independent per device.

Earlier leaks suggest the subscription may cost about $4.99 a month or $47.99 a year, and include new features such as Bixby actions, the daily summary, and video generation, and it may initially be limited to the upcoming Galaxy S27 series. The important warning: Samsung has not officially announced any of this, so prices, limits, and details could all change before launch.

Simply put: imagine a free feature on your phone staying free, but if you want more of it you must pay a monthly subscription — and then also pay from a points balance every time you edit a card; that is what Samsung's new model looks like, as the leak revealed.
Would you accept paying a monthly subscription for AI features on your phone, or do you prefer them to stay free?
